"cvss_v4": {"score": 0.0, "vector_string": null}}, "cwes": [{"cwe_id": "CWE-27", "name": "Path Traversal: 'dir/../../filename'"}], "description": "### Impact

moment before 2.31.0 is vulnerable to path traversal in `moment.locale()`. When an application passes a non-string, attacker-influenced value to `moment.locale()`, a specially crafted object can bypass the locale name validation and cause moment to load a file from an attacker-controlled path. This is a further bypass of the validation added in 2.29.2 for [CVE-2022-24785](https://github.com/moment/moment/security/advisories/GHSA-8hfj-j24r-96c4).

This affects server-side (npm) users only. Plain string input is not affected: the existing validation correctly rejects strings that contain path separators.

### Patches

This issue is patched in moment 2.31.0.

### Workarounds

Validate that any user-supplied input is a string before passing it to `moment.locale()`.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00357, "percentile": 0.26649}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-29T23:46:02Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-17495"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-09-15T06:16:57Z", "published_at": "2026-09-29T23:46:02Z", "references": ["https://github.com/moment/moment/security/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-17495", "https://github.com/moment/moment/pull/6386", "https://github.com/moment/moment/commit/5f7d983c9881e65e07574de9dda3190d99520c07", "https://cna.openjsf.org/security-advisories.html", "https://github.com/moment/moment/releases/tag/2.31.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/moment/moment/security-advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/moment/moment", "summary": "moment vulnerable to Path Traversal via crafted non-string locale name", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-29T23:46:04Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "2.31.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "moment"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 2.29.2, < 2.31.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
